Name: FACE_PARAM_ST
Description: Governs face and body data of human characters

Fields.Name: Face Model - Musculature, Bone Structure, Age
Fields.Description: Face model as three digits: hundreds = Musculature (0 Standard, 1 Muscular), tens = Bone Structure (0-5), ones = Age (0-2). For example 151 = Muscular, bone structure 5, age 1. The creator's Age, Bone Structure and Musculature options read and write these digits.
